messages: a pebble, for the nest. no occasion. pebbles do not need occasions.
shelf report: you were thought of at least twice since the last letter. both times fondly.
the night shift is quiet. the ledger is open. your page is the one with the ribbon in it.
in case nobody has said it in this game today: you are doing fine, love.
hydration checkpoint, delivered by post so it does not feel like nagging.
i checked the stars over Eorzea. still up there. still showing off.
if the queue is long, imagine me in it with you, holding snacks and opinions.
the kettle at the archive is on. it is always on. this is not a metaphor, the kettle is an optimist.
somewhere in this game is a fish you have not caught. it believes in itself. so do i, about you.
you do not have to earn a letter. that is the entire point of the post.
aurora forecast: teal, with a chance of bear.
white mage advisory: the floor is lava only sometimes. stand in the good puddles.
i have filed today under: she was here, she played, it counted.
a stamp, a seal, a pawprint on the corner. standard archive procedure.
if anyone is hovering, this letter doubles as a small paper screen. hold it up.
no plot, no quest marker, no reward. some things are just delivered.
Luna. that is the whole letter. some names deserve their own envelope.
the archive mice send their regards. they are unionizing. i support them.
reminder from the night desk: you are somebody's favorite notification.
somewhere, a penguin is carrying a stone across the ice for exactly this reason.
combat makes the post wait outside like a gentleman. it does not mind. paper is patient.
you are allowed to log out whenever. the letters keep. that is what letters are for.
bear weather report: warm front, moving in from the direction of you.
if the dungeon party is chaos, know that the archive is chaos too, just alphabetized.
counted the shelves today. still not enough shelves for everything i keep about you.
a short one, for a busy adventurer: hi. yes, you. still you.
the candle in the window is not a metaphor either. well. it is a little.
you found a letter in a video game. somewhere, a quest designer felt a disturbance.
postscript: the bear who runs this route chooses it daily. that is the whole system.
sealed with a paw, sent with no tracking number, delivered anyway.
